Overview.Name: Sujatha Kulkarni
Overview.Goal: Fat loss, better appearance, increased energy, confidence, health improvement, and stress reduction.

Early_Morning (optional): Option 1: Warm water (200 ml) + small bowl curd (150 g)
Option 2: Warm water (200 ml) + full fat milk (200 ml)
Option 3: Warm water (200 ml) + buttermilk (200 ml)
Breakfast: Option 1: Rice poha (80 g) with vegetables (50 g) + peanuts (10 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 2: Rice rawa upma (80 g) with vegetables (50 g) + small bowl curd (100 g)
Option 3: Paneer curry (150 g) + small portion rice (80 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + vegetable curry (100 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 2: Plain rice (150 g) + sambar (150 g) + vegetable fry (100 g) + buttermilk (150 ml)
Option 3: Plain rice (150 g) + paneer curry (150 g) + leafy vegetable curry (100 g)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Puffed rice (30 g) with boiled chickpeas (50 g) + cucumber (50 g)
Option 2: Roasted makhana (30 g) + small fruit (100 g)
Option 3: Boiled green gram (50 g) with tomato (50 g) and cucumber (50 g)
Dinner: Option 1: Dal (150 g) + small portion rice (100 g) + vegetable curry (100 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 2: Paneer curry (150 g) + rice (100 g) + leafy vegetable fry (100 g)
Option 3: Mixed vegetable curry (150 g) + rice (100 g) + dal (100 g) + buttermilk (150 ml)

Notes_and_Tips: Strictly avoid gluten and soy; use rice as the main carb with moderate portions.
Maintain consistent meal times to help manage diabetes and thyroid.
Include leafy vegetables daily and choose paneer/dal for protein.
For cravings: drink water first, then have curd or a small portion of puffed rice.
At social gatherings: eat your regular meal before going and take only small portions.
Keep meals regular (3 per day) to stabilise blood sugar and thyroid function.
